mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_purchase WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM biz_purchase WHERE purchase_no = #{purchaseNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, purchase_no, platform, platform_order_no, supplier_name, seller_account, purchase_date, item_count, purchase_status, goods_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, other_amount, pay_amount, payment_method, received_at, remark, created_at FROM biz_purchase WHERE deleted = 0
AND (purchase_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR seller_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND purchase_status = #{purchaseStatus}
ORDER BY purchase_date DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_purchase ( purchase_no, platform, platform_order_no, supplier_name, seller_account, purchase_date, item_count, purchase_status, goods_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, other_amount, pay_amount, invoice_status, payment_method, received_at, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{purchaseNo}, #{platform}, #{platformOrderNo}, #{supplierName}, #{sellerAccount}, #{purchaseDate}, #{itemCount}, #{purchaseStatus}, #{goodsAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{otherAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{invoiceStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{receivedAt}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_purchase SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
